appraisal_events.evidence: Mme de Guermantes eût juré qu'il était né dans son monde et avait été bercé sur les genoux de la duchesse de Chartres quand il avait deux ans.
appraisal_events.explanation: Because she has forgotten how recently she met him, Mme de Guermantes' memory retroactively grants Bloch an invented aristocratic pedigree, a comic elevation the narrator frames as an illusion of forgetting rather than a real judgment.

appraisal_events.evidence: Legrandin méprisait Bloch autrefois et ne lui adressait jamais la parole. Il fut très aimable avec lui.
appraisal_events.explanation: Legrandin, who once scorned Bloch and refused to speak to him, is now very amiable with him; the narrator explicitly attributes this reversal to selective memory rather than to any real change in Bloch's standing.

status_effects.explanation: Bloch moves locally from a remembered position of contempt and silence into one of amiable inclusion and imagined aristocratic belonging, even though the passage frames both shifts as products of others' forgetting rather than genuine reassessment.

ambiguities: Both movements toward Bloch (Guermantes' invented memory of his origins, Legrandin's new amiability) are explicitly presented by the narrator as artifacts of forgetting rather than genuine appraisal, so the 'elevation' is qualified by irony about memory's unreliability rather than endorsed as a real judgment of Bloch.
